title: South Korea's Largest AI Model Launches: LG Unveils 750 Billion-Parameter K-EXAONE 2.0 Apache Open Source to Compete with Chinese Models

content_html:
LG AI Research Institute officially released the K-EXAONE 2.0 model on Hugging Face on July 31, which is the second-generation product developed under the Sovereign AI Foundation Model Project of the Korea Ministry of Science and Information and Communication Technology. The new model adopts a hybrid attention MoE architecture, with a total of 750 billion parameters and 37 billion activated parameters, more than three times the size of the first generation, and is also the largest artificial intelligence foundation model ever developed in South Korea.

Notably, K-EXAONE 2.0 is fully open source under the Apache 2.0 license, which is quite rare in the history of AI development in South Korea.

Performance has been significantly improved, directly competing with Chinese open-source models

Vertically, K-EXAONE 2.0 scored an average of 70.1 points in 24 benchmark tests, an increase of over 10% compared to the initial version's 63.3 points. Performance improvements reached about 30% in three coding and agent coding benchmark tests. Horizontally, it is even more ambitious - it outperforms Zhipu GLM-5.1 in long context understanding, and it also surpasses GLM-5.1 and Qwen3.5 in agent tool usage capabilities. In instruction execution evaluation, it is on par with GLM-5.1, DeepSeek V4 Pro Max, and Qwen3.5.

From the first generation to 2.0, LG AI Research Institute increased the model parameter scale by more than three times within one generation, and directly competes with top Chinese open-source models in key indicators. With the global competition for open-source models triggered by Kimi K3 still heating up, South Korea has joined the race under the name of sovereign AI, indicating that the triangular competition pattern in the East Asian open-source AI ecosystem is taking shape.

content_html_zh:
LG AI研究院于7月31日在Hugging Face上正式发布了K-EXAONE 2.0模型，这是韩国科学技术部和信息通信技术部主权AI基础模型项目下开发的第二代产品。 新模型采用混合注意力MoE架构，共有7500亿个参数和370亿个激活参数，规模是第一代的三倍多，也是韩国有史以来开发的最大的人工智能基础模型。

值得注意的是，K-EXAONE 2.0在Apache 2.0许可下完全开源，这在韩国人工智能发展史上相当罕见。

性能显着提升，直接与中国开源模型竞争

纵向来看，K-EXAONE 2.0 在 24 项基准测试中平均得分为 70.1 分，较初始版本的 63.3 分提升超过 10%。 在三个编码和代理编码基准测试中，性能提升达到约 30%。 横向上，它的野心更大——在长上下文理解上超越了智普GLM-5.1，在代理工具使用能力上也超越了GLM-5.1和Qwen3.5。 在指令执行评估方面，它与GLM-5.1、DeepSeek V4 Pro Max和Qwen3.5相当。

从第一代到2.0，LG AI研究院在一代内将模型参数规模提升了三倍以上，在关键指标上与中国顶尖开源模型直接竞争。 在Kimi K3引发的全球开源模型竞争愈演愈烈的情况下，韩国以主权AI之名加入这场竞赛，表明东亚开源AI生态系统的三角竞争格局正在形成。
